reason: It looks nice and I like the idea, but I would be paying 120 euros up front to a brand-new company for something that does not exist yet. I have never managed to leave my phone in another room, so I doubt a second object would change that.
objection: How accurate can a sleep and snoring estimate from a microphone be? And is it worth 120 euros to hand money to a startup before I have seen one working, when my phone already does the alarm for free.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working in a real review or a friend's home, plus a price nearer 90 euros once it is actually shipping.
